capabilities: Open a Google Photos search for the active note's date

Parse dates from note filenames using the Daily Notes format or overrides
Collect dates from outgoing links, embeds, frontmatter links and daily-note backlinks

disambiguation: Does not search photos stored in the vault; it opens date-filtered searches in Google Photos or Immich.
extras: The listing carries an Obsidian staff note: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to open a photo service already filtered to the date of the note you are viewing.
